title: papaver somniferum var. hortense
intro: Papaver somniferum var. hortense, commonly known as the opium poppy, is a cultivated variety of the opium poppy plant that is known for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Papaver somniferum var. hortense include pain relief, improved sleep, and reduced inflammation, making it a valuable natural remedy for various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant include sedative, analgesic, and antispasmodic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids such as morphine and codeine. The bioactive constituents of Papaver somniferum var. hortense also include other alkaloids like thebaine, papaverine, and noscapine, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
